name: Question 15
problem:
The linear transformation $T$ has the standard matrix 

$$
T=[\begin{aligned}6 & 1 \\ 3 & -2\end{aligned}].
$$

 
What are the respective images of the standard basis vectors ${i,j}$ of ${R}^{2}$ under the action of $T?$
worked_solution:
**Method 1**

The images of the vectors in the standard basis ${i,j}$ are the first and second columns of $T,$ respectively. 

Therefore, we have the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}T(i) & =T[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}6 \\ 3\end{aligned}] \\ T(j) & =T[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

**Method 2**

We can find the images of the vectors in the standard basis ${i,j}$ by computing the matrix products $T\cdot i$ and $T\cdot j:$

$$
\begin{aligned}T(i) & =T\cdot i=[\begin{aligned}6 & 1 \\ 3 & -2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}6 \\ 3\end{aligned}] \\ T(j) & =T\cdot j=[\begin{aligned}6 & 1 \\ 3 & -2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Question 15
?

The linear transformation T has the standard matrix T=[613−2]. What are the respective images of the standard basis vectors {i,j} of R2 under the action of T?

a
[63] and [−12]
b
[61] and [3−2]
c
[−36] and [1−2]
d
[63] and [1−2]
e
[36] and [1−2]
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

Method 1

The images of the vectors in the standard basis {i,j} are the first and second columns of T, respectively.

Therefore, we have the following:

T(i)=T[10]=[63]T(j)=T[01]=[1−2]

Method 2

We can find the images of the vectors in the standard basis {i,j} by computing the matrix products T⋅i and T⋅j:

T(i)=T⋅i=[613−2][10]=[63]T(j)=T⋅j=[613−2][01]=[1−2]
